headline_marked: Anthropic is developing [[FlashProve, an open-source system to verify AI model identity]] for outputs
headline: Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open-source system to verify AI model identity for outputs
summary: FlashProve offers "provable inference," a cryptographic proof that an AI output came from a specific model, preventing secret model swaps or false claims.
details: Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open-source system designed to verify which AI model produced a given output. This system aims to provide "provable inference," a cryptographic proof that mathematically guarantees an output's origin. It ensures users can confirm they are interacting with the intended model.

FlashProve is built to be robust against impostors, even preventing AI labs from secretly swapping in cheaper models to cut costs or more expensive ones to inflate performance results. It can also verify third-party claims that a specific task was completed by an advanced AI model.

The system requires AI labs to publish a unique "fingerprint" for each model, which can then be cryptographically matched to outputs without revealing the model's private weights. This allows commercial models to participate while protecting proprietary information. Verification can also be performed efficiently on local devices.

Anthropic has released a detailed technical specification and working code for elements of FlashProve under an open-source license on GitHub. This is an ongoing research project, with no immediate plans for deployment by Anthropic or other labs, shared to encourage community contribution and improvement.
